events.title: Everett Float Find 2026
events.desc: Calling all treasure hunters! One-of-a-kind glass floats are waiting for you in Everett. On Fridays in July and August, 10 clue balls will be hidden on the waterfront (five in the morning and five in the afternoon). Find one and turn it in for a glass float! You can make a day of it on the waterfront, where you’ll find amazing restaurants, ice cream and even a splash pad. There will also be 20 …

events.title: Seafair Weekend: Blue Angels Air Show and Hydro Races
events.cost: Gate admission is free on Friday; otherwise $23–$55 for general gate admission; ages 12 and younger are free
events.loc: Genesee Park and Playfield , 4316 S. Genesee St., Seattle
events.desc: Whether you want to join the free festivities on Friday or splurge on tickets for Saturday and Sunday, Seafair Weekend packs a ton of fun into each day. From hydroplane races to aerial acrobatics, the kids are sure to be amazed. Plus, there will be live music and delicious food! (Psst … Want to pair plane-watching with plenty more festivities and fantastic exhibits? Head to The Museum of Flight…

events.title: Art in Nature Walk
events.desc: If your family loves walking trails and admiring incredible art, I have just the weekend event for you. Outdoor art installations have been installed across Snoqualmie Valley, with more than 167 artists contributing to these open-air galleries. Each art walk is around a mile, meaning little legs can keep up. And if you fall in love with one of the pieces of artwork, you might be in luck: Many a…

events.title: American Crown Circus
events.loc: Puget Sound Park , 135 S.W. 126th St., Burien
events.desc: Step under the big top this weekend for a K pop-inspired circus performance! There will be all the circus favorites — from aerial performances to cotton candy and popcorn — with a “K-Pop Demon Hunters” twist. So keep your eyes out for Huntrix performers, and note that dressing up is encouraged!

events.title: Lake City Summer Festival and Parade
events.loc: Northeast 125th Street , Between 25th Avenue Northeast and Lake City Way Northeast, Seattle
events.desc: There’s no chance of boredom at this fantastic festival. Join the kids as they pet farmyard friends in the free petting zoo, listen to live music, and admire classic rides in the car show. You can also expect a variety of craft vendors and food trucks. Plus, there will be not one, but three parades.

events.title: Kite Festival at Chambers Creek Park
events.loc: Chambers Creek Regional Park – Central Meadows , 6320 Grandview Dr. S.W., University Place
events.desc: There is nothing my daughter loves more than a windy day that’s perfect for flying a kite. (A rainbow unicorn kite, specifically.) There will be plenty of colorful, fantastic kites to admire at this annual festival. Bring your own or purchase a kite kit on-site and join the fun. Show up early for the chance at a free kite! You can also expect inflatables, special activities and food trucks.

events.title: Umoja Fest and Parade
events.loc: Judkins Park , 2150 S Norman St., Seattle
events.desc: This unity-themed fest celebrates the history, culture and contributions of Seattle’s Black community. Experience fashion, live music, food and more from the African diaspora. You can also expect basketball and football tournaments, a vendor marketplace and kids activities. Don’t miss Saturday’s parade!

events.title: Al Fresco on Front
events.loc: Downtown Issaquah , Front Street between West Sunset Way and Northwest Dogwood Street, Issaquah
events.desc: You won’t see any cars on a stretch of Front Street this weekend — or any weekend in August, for that matter. The historic downtown street will transform into the perfect pedestrian experience, with outdoor dining, sidewalk shopping, live music and more. Kids will love the mini golf course and ping-pong, plus (parents, be warned) the mountains of foam.

events.title: Kitsap Forest Theater Presents ‘Oliver!’
events.cost: $25–$30 adult; $12–$15 youth; ages 5 and younger are free
events.loc: Kitsap Forest Theater , 3153 Seabeck Hwy. N.W., Bremerton
events.desc: Kitsap Forest Theater is bringing “Oliver!” back to its outdoor stage for the first time in more than 20 years, and you don’t want to miss it. See the classic story of a young orphan in Victorian London unfold between towering fir trees. Just be prepared for a song or two (like “Food, Glorious Food”) to get stuck in your head.

events.title: Maris Farms Summerfest
events.loc: Maris Farms , 25001 Sumner Buckley Hwy., Buckley
events.desc: There’s no surer sign of August than the bright yellow faces of sunflowers blooming in fields. Maris Farms has fields of the cheerful flowers, along with a brand-new butterfly house and plenty of farm attractions. Ride the giant slide, shop for handmade gifts and say hi to the farm animals. Sounds like a perfect summer day to me!
